description: A reconstruction capture includes its own synthetic read and excludes a later synthetic close (engine §4 and §7).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late #·_<_Elided>
%elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a (X [+T] [+U])
%rule b (X [+T] [+U] [+V])
%rule c ($x:body U) %conditions $x.without-elision.parse(rival), ¬$x.without-elision.parse(wrong)

%rule body (X T)
%rule rival (X [+T])
%rule wrong (X [+T] [+U])
